headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, with AI‑driven earnings picking up.
summary: TCS posted ₹73,188 cr revenue and a 24% operating margin, confirming steady growth. HCLTech and L&T Technology reported double‑digit YoY revenue gains, helped by AI sales. Wipro grew revenue modestly but saw profit dip, while Infosys and several peers have not yet released results. Overall sentiment is positive but mixed on earnings quality.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue rose sharply at HCLTech, LTM and Wipro, supporting higher margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: TCS maintained a 24% margin, but Wipro’s margin slipped to 16.5% and profit fell YoY.

themes.title: Revenue guidance uncertainty
themes.detail: Only HCLTech provided FY27 guidance; Wipro introduced Q3 guidance, while others remain silent.

leaders.why: Largest revenue base with 24% operating margin and 15.4% YoY growth.
Strong AI revenue (+78% YoY) and solid profit growth (+21% YoY).
Highest YoY revenue growth (≈20%) among peers with a healthy dividend.

laggards.why: Results not released yet, creating uncertainty.
Negative sentiment despite revenue jump; share price fell.
Revenue growth slowed and net profit declined YoY.

domain_outlook.note: No explicit mentions of media or broadcasting in the reports.
No explicit mentions of entertainment or streaming.
